(2) The camera moves as the Corgi rolls over and both dogs approach the lens, sniffing and jumping excitedly. A woman wearing a black shirt and holding a plastic bag walks across the background. The lighting is bright and even, coming from overhead fixtures. (3) The camera pans around, revealing a TV mounted on the wall, a large world map, and various storage bins. The person filming is wearing green pants and white clogs, occasionally appearing in the frame as they move. (4) The camera leads the two dogs toward an open doorway. The Corgis look up with tongues out and ears alert, showing high excitement. Beyond the door, a glimpse of an outdoor urban street with a parked motorcycle is visible.
